review_candidates.title: Gerente de Planejamento de Obra
review_candidates.description: Descrição ❇️ Conduzir o planejamento estratégico e o controle integrado de obras, programas de investimento e empreendimentos de infraestrutura, assegurando o equilíbrio entre prazo, custo, escopo, riscos e utilização dos recursos disponíveis. Esta posição possui papel fundamental na governança dos investimentos da organização, liderando processos de planejamento, controle físico-financeiro, gestão de indicadores, acompanhamento contratual e suporte à tomada de decisão executiva. Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, capacidade analítica, forte orientação para resultados e experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a excelência operacional, sustentabilidade dos investimentos e geração de valor para o negócio. ⏱️ Horário: De segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h00 às 18h00 com 1h12 de intervalo. ️ Vale Alimentação / Refeição – apoio para suas refeições diárias; Cesta de Natal – um carinho especial no fim do ano; Plano de Saúde – cuidado completo para você; Plano Odontológico – saúde bucal sempre em dia; ️ Seguro de Vida sem custo – proteção para você e sua família; Vale Transporte – facilidade no deslocamento diário; Auxílio Medicamento – suporte financeiro para tratamentos e prescrições; ️ Wellhub – acesso a academias e atividades físicas; Pluxee Cuida – apoio psicológico, social, nutricional e consultorias; Previdência Privada – com 100% de contribuição no aporte da empresa; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) – reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho. Responsabilidades e atribuições Gerenciar o planejamento físico-financeiro de obras, programas de investimento e empreendimentos de infraestrutura, assegurando o alinhamento entre escopo, prazo, custo e recursos disponíveis. Definir metodologias, procedimentos, premissas e critérios corporativos para planejamento, programação, monitoramento e controle da execução dos empreendimentos. Consolidar cronogramas executivos, linhas de base, curvas de avanço, histogramas de recursos e demais instrumentos de gestão necessários ao acompanhamento dos investimentos. Liderar processos de planejamento, replanejamento e priorização de investimentos, promovendo a melhor alocação dos recursos disponíveis. Gerenciar o controle integrado dos empreendimentos, acompanhando a evolução física e financeira das obras e promovendo ações corretivas e preventivas quando necessário. Garantir a confiabilidade das informações gerenciais relacionadas aos empreendimentos, apoiando a tomada de decisão da alta liderança. Gerenciar a elaboração, revisão e acompanhamento dos cronogramas físico-financeiros dos projetos e obras, avaliando impactos de mudanças de escopo, riscos, restrições e oportunidades. Avaliar e aprovar estudos de viabilidade técnica, análises de produtividade, estimativas de custos, projeções de investimento e cenários de execução. Definir, acompanhar e analisar indicadores estratégicos de desempenho relacionados a prazo, custo, produtividade, avanço físico e eficiência operacional. Desenvolver e acompanhar relatórios executivos, dashboards gerenciais, forecasts e análises críticas voltadas ao desempenho dos empreendimentos. Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Engenharia, Operações, Suprimentos, Projetos, Comercial, Controladoria e demais áreas de interface, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento e execução. Deliberar sobre revisões de cronogramas, planos de ação e medidas de mitigação de riscos que possam impactar custos, prazos, qualidade ou desempenho dos empreendimentos. Promover o acompanhamento contratual de fornecedores e subcontratados sob a ótica do planejamento, monitorando desempenho, obrigações contratuais e marcos de execução. Gerenciar a carteira de contratos sob sua responsabilidade, apoiando análises de medições, aditivos contratuais, pleitos e reequilíbrios econômico-financeiros quando aplicáveis. Elaborar, propor, aprovar e acompanhar o orçamento anual das empresas e unidades de negócio sob sua responsabilidade, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos. Responder pelo desempenho econômico-financeiro da área, monitorando indicadores de eficiência, produtividade e utilização dos investimentos aprovados. Aprovar a contratação de serviços especializados, consultorias, sistemas, ferramentas e recursos necessários à gestão dos empreendimentos. Liderar equipes de planejamento, promovendo desenvolvimento técnico, gestão de desempenho, sucessão e formação de talentos. Definir metas, indicadores e objetivos da área, monitorando resultados e implementando ações voltadas à melhoria contínua. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos legais, regulatórios, contratuais e corporativos aplicáveis aos processos de planejamento e controle dos empreendimentos. Promover as diretrizes corporativas de qualidade, saúde e segurança ocupacional, meio ambiente, governança e gestão de riscos. Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações, análises e evidências relacionadas aos investimentos e empreendimentos corporativos. Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Ensino Superior e MBA / Especializações. Áreas de formação em Engenharia Civil, Sanitária, Ambiental, Elétrica ou correlatas. Áreas de Especializações em Gestão de Projetos, Gerenciamento de Obras, Planejamento, Infraestrutura, Engenharia Econômica, Finanças ou áreas correlatas. ️⃣ Experiência consolidada em planejamento e controle de obras, projetos de infraestrutura ou programas de investimento; ️⃣ Experiência no setor de saneamento, concessões, utilidades, infraestrutura ou construção pesada; ️⃣ Experiência em gestão físico-financeira de empreendimentos, acompanhamento de cronogramas executivos e controle orçamentário; ️⃣ Vivência com gestão de equipes técnicas e multidisciplinares; ️⃣ Conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho, forecast, gestão de custos, CAPEX, OPEX e análise de desvios; ️⃣ Experiência na elaboração e análise de cronogramas físico-financeiros; ️⃣ Conhecimento em gestão de contratos, medições, aditivos e acompanhamento contratual de empreendimentos; ️⃣ Conhecimento em análise de riscos aplicada a projetos e investimentos; ️⃣ Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de análise gerencial. Benefícios Vale Alimentação / Refeição; Cesta de Natal; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida sem custo; Vale Transporte; Auxílio Medicamento; Wellhub; Pluxee Cuida; Previdência Privada; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

review_candidates.title: Foundation Engineer I
review_candidates.description: Job Description Nextpower –Foundation Engineer I Location : Mexico City, Mexico Reporting : Director, Civil and Geotechnical Engineering Work Type: Hybrid - 4 days in office, 1 day remote Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (C1/C2 level required) Nextpower is the leading provider of intelligent, integrated solar tracker and software solutions used in utility-scale and ground-mounted distributed generation solar projects around the world. Nextpower has been the number one global market-share solar tracker company with an average market share of 30% for seven years and counting, according to global research firms Wood Mackenzie and IHS Markit. Nextpower pioneered smart solar tracking technology and continues to lead the industry with our design, engineering and software innovation. Our robust portfolio of intellectual property protects both our hardware and software products, and includes 132 mechanical patents, 52 electronics & controls patents, and 171 software-driven yield improvement patents. At Nextpower, we are on a mission to be the most trusted and valued renewable energy company by delivering intelligent, reliable, and productive solar power. We are a diverse group of technology innovators and clean energy activators. We are collaborative team players, accountable and deliver results. We are committed to sustainability, decarbonization and a better tomorrow. About The Role Nextpower is seeking a Foundation Engineer I to join our Project Engineering Team in Mexico City, Mexico , supporting key accounts across the U.S and North America markets. This position will be responsible for managing day-to-day structural engineering tasks for foundations of utility-scale PV projects from the development phase through construction. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, wind load calculations, steel design, component sizing, foundation sizing, foundation tool development and the preparation of foundation documentation to support project quoting and engineering packages. The role will involve close coordination with cross-functional teams in the U.S., India, and other global offices including Sales, Project Management, and R&D. Key Responsibilities Produce civil and structural design documentation, including drawings and calculations. Support the project development phase by reviewing site information, performing calculations, and contributing to cost estimations. Perform structural analyses for wind, seismic, and foundation loads, and prepare corresponding calculations and reports; sign/seal documents if required. Provide construction phase support by responding to RFIs and reviewing submittals. Develop a comprehensive understanding of Nextpower products to support engineering decisions. Collaborate with structural/Geotechnical/Civil Engineers across regions to maintain and update standards, specifications, templates, and design tools. Manage schedules and review deliverables from structural and Foundation engineering consultants. Support the ongoing development and expansion of Nextpower’s Design Services team. Occasional sites visit to supervise Geotech investigations, foundation installation and pile load testing. Required Skills/ Expertise: BS in Structural/Geotechnical Engineering with emphasis on Foundations. MS in Structural or Geotechnical Engineering is a plus. Good knowledge of international engineering standards, codes, and other applicable state and federal guidelines, including but not limited to IBC, ASCE, ASTM, AISC, and ACI. Proficiency in finite element analysis software (RISA, STAAD, Opensees or equivalent) Proficiency in advanced modal and dynamic analysis Minimum of 2 years of structural/Geotechnical engineering experience, preferably in the solar industry. Demonstrated experience in structural design, including dead, live, snow, wind, and seismic loads, as well as steel structure design and construction documentation. Proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel), AutoCAD, Proficiency in foundation tools like LPILE/AllPile, Risa foundation, Staad foundations, Plaxis and other tools. Proficiency in programming languages is a plus. Self-motivated team player with strong communication and collaboration skills. Passion for renewable energy and solar power is a plus. Fluent English is required to communicate effectively with clients, manage international projects, and produce high-quality technical documentation. Nextpower offers a comprehensive benefits package. We provide health care coverage, dental and vision, 401(K) participation including company matching, company paid holidays with unlimited paid time off, generous discretionary company bonuses, life and disability protection and more. Employees in certain positions may be eligible for stock compensation. All plans are in accordance with relevant plan documents. For more information on Nextpowers benefits please view our company website at www.Nextpower.com. At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. We are Nextpower

review_candidates.title: Director of Commercial Construction
review_candidates.description: North Georgia Civil Inc./NGC General Contractors Director of Commercial Construction Salary: $150,000 - $190,000 per year Location: Danielsville, GA (Athens-area office). Office-based, Monday through Friday, with 25%-40% travel to project sites across multiple states. HQ is relocating to the I-85 corridor in the Braselton/Jefferson area within the next 6-12 months. Reports to: VP of Commercial Construction Run the Portfolio. Lead the Team. Drive the Growth. North Georgia Civil Inc. , also known as NGC General Contractors , is a rapidly growing commercial, civil, and telecommunications contractor headquartered in Danielsville, Georgia. NGC delivers federal facility renovations, commercial construction, civil, utility, and infrastructure projects across multiple states. Our commercial division specializes in occupied-building renovations, MEP and HVAC upgrades, fire and life safety systems, EV charging infrastructure, dock improvements, and sitework. We manage major capital projects alongside high-volume job order contracts and task-order projects. NGC is seeking an experienced Director of Commercial Construction to lead our commercial project portfolio, oversee Project Managers, and drive successful project delivery across multiple locations. This senior leadership position requires someone who understands general contracting operations, can manage multiple projects, protect profitability, develop Project Managers, and resolve complex construction challenges. The ideal candidate will come from a commercial general contracting background , preferably with previous experience as a Director of Construction, Director of Operations, or similar leadership position. We will also consider an exceptional Senior Project Manager from a leading general contractor who has demonstrated strong leadership and portfolio management capabilities. We need someone who can take ownership of an entire construction portfolio, make sound commercial decisions, and build the team and systems required for continued growth. Key Responsibilities Construction Portfolio Management Oversee multiple commercial and federal construction projects, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and high-quality delivery. Lead weekly portfolio reviews covering schedules, budgets, cost forecasts, change orders, subcontractor performance, and project issues. Identify underperforming projects and implement corrective action plans. Resolve scheduling conflicts, subcontractor disputes, cost overruns, and operational challenges. Maintain effective communication with owners, construction managers, and project stakeholders. Ensure projects are properly documented and closed out, including punch lists, warranties, and closeout packages. Oversee construction in occupied facilities while minimizing disruption to operations. Project Financial Management and Profitability Take responsibility for the financial performance of the commercial construction portfolio. Review project budgets, job costs, forecasts, commitments, and profitability with Project Managers. Oversee monthly work-in-progress (WIP) reporting, including percentage of completion, cost to complete, and over/under billings. Les prochaines années porteront sur la poursuite de la transformation de l’offre avec une dimension territoriale. Également, l’établissement a installé en septembre de façon permanente une équipe médico-sociale au sein du collège Marguerite Duras à Libourne, afin de promouvoir une inclusion maximale. La création de nouvelles unités d’enseignement externalisées est prévue dans les 2 ans. L’appui à la scolarisation dans l’environnement scolaire ordinaire, l’appui à la formation professionnelle, l’accompagnement vers et dans l’emploi, les apprentissages éducatifs pour le développement de l’autonomie (mobilité, habitat, vie sociale…) sont les axes majeurs du projet du dispositif. Ses orientations sont soutenues par des accompagnements éducatifs fondés sur des approches psychoéducatives, répondant aux recommandations de bonnes pratiques de la haute autorité de santé. Les structures s’engagent dans une démarche de certification Handéo. Promouvoir l’inclusion scolaire par un développement renforcé du partenariat avec l’éducation nationale Promouvoir les parcours d’inclusion en termes de formation professionnelle, d’accès l’emploi, de vie sociale, d’accès à un logement. Organiser, en lien avec les cadres, la mise en œuvre et l’évaluation des projets personnalisés en veillant à leur cohérence avec le projet d’établissement et les demandes des jeunes et de leur famille, tout en favorisant leur participation dans une dynamique de co-construction. Promouvoir les démarches d’amélioration continue de la qualité et la gestion des risques. Lancer la démarche de certification Cap Handéo pour tout le périmètre (IME, SESSAD, SESSAD pro) Gérer et animer les ressources humaines avec l’appui de l’équipe de cadres. review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join us as a Concrete Tower Structures Designer at Siemens Energy, where you will play a pivotal role in advancing our SG7.0 and SG7.X hybrid concrete tower portfolio. Imagine leading the detailed structural design and numerical modeling of pre-stressed and post-stressed concrete structures, ensuring a seamless transition to optimized future designs. You will engage in executing cost-out actions while balancing structural integrity and dynamic behavior throughout the product lifecycle. Your expertise will directly contribute to the in-house CREST hybrid concrete tower development, making a significant impact on our mission to innovate in the energy sector. How You’ll Make An Impact Design and analyze complex pre-stressed, post-stressed, pre-cast, and in-situ concrete tower structures and foundations. Perform fatigue design and dynamic behavior calculations to ensure long-term operational reliability of cracked and uncracked concrete structures. Apply international design standards, including Eurocodes, Model Codes, and ACI, to guarantee regulatory compliance and successful certification. Develop linear and non-linear finite element models (FEA) using Abaqus or Ansys to analyze complex load cases and conduct soil-structure interaction analyses. Identify and implement cost-out actions and design optimization activities for the SG7.0, SG7.X, and CREST hybrid concrete tower portfolios, providing technical support during the construction phase. What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline. At least 5 years of professional experience in concrete structures design and foundation design, with a preference for experience in wind turbine generator development or heavy industrial structures. Strong skills in structural engineering and concrete design, including pre-stressed and post-stressed concrete design, as well as high-performance and fiber-reinforced concrete technology. Proficiency in finite element analysis (FEA) using Abaqus or Ansys, with experience in linear and non-linear structural modeling and fatigue calculations. A solid understanding of cost-out analysis, manufacturing processes, and programming languages such as Matlab, Python, or VBA, along with CAD tools like NX or Catia. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. review_candidates.description: Company Description NAPEO – The National Association of Professional Employer Organizations is The Voice of the PEO Industry TM . PEOs provide payroll, benefits, workers’ comp, regulatory compliance assistance and other HR services to more than 230,000 small and mid-size businesses employing 5.4 million people nationwide. NAPEO represents the interests of the PEO industry on behalf of a membership that includes both PEOs and companies that provide services to PEOs. Role Description: The communications coordinator works with other professionals in all areas of the organization to develop, edit and manage distribution of the association’s communications, including newsletters, email alerts, promotional materials and online information, ensuring that all communications are presented in a professional, insightful and effective way. This is a full-time, hybrid position based in Old Town Alexandria, VA, requiring three days in-office and two days remote. Responsibilities Write, edit and/or proofread NAPEO member communications, including meeting notices, promotions, government affairs alerts and all other member-related materials. Coordinate and execute distribution of mass emails. Compile weekly online newsletter of PEO industry news and bi-weekly update on NAPEO activities and issues. Oversee relationship with social media vendor, including coordinating the content calendar, providing strategic direction, recommending and approving content, and ensuring consistent, high-quality messaging across all platforms. Navigate association management system to run queries and lists for distribution of NAPEO member communications. Update and organize information on NAPEO’s website. Facilitate development and production of NAPEO’s year in review and conference materials. Assist in management and production of NAPEO’s monthly magazine, including uploading articles to the website, coordinating mailing lists and follow-up mailings and serving as a liaison with magazine authors. Provide support, input and ideas for NAPEO’s efforts to create consistent messaging about the industry that advances the association advocacy efforts. Other duties as assigned. Requirements 1-3 years of experience in a position that included writing, editing/proofreading, scheduling and project coordination Basic layout skills and competency with design tools such as Illustrator, InDesign and Canva Familiarity with WordPress Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism or related field Skills Ability to collaborate effectively with individuals at all levels and disciplines within the organization Excellent written and verbal communication skills Keen attention to detail Proficiency in Microsoft Office software products, including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint. Additional Requirements Ability to work at a computer for long periods of time. Ability to stand for long periods of time during trade shows, conferences and other events. Ability to lift and carry up to 20 lbs. without assistance. Ability to travel 2-3 times per year.
